description: SHA-256 of the dated 16 October 2026 live-evaluation artifacts, and of the record of the code defaults in force during that study. These files are evidence and must never change; corrections go into a dated errata section or a sidecar file, and new runs write new dated files (scripts/live/lib/writeOnce.js). Checked by test FH-1 (tests/researchIntegrity.unit.test.js) and by checkManuscriptNumbers.
computedFrom: working-tree files. The run outputs are byte-identical to the blobs at commit 6dbe6b8. study_code_defaults_2026-10-16.json is not a run output: it was extracted on 2026-10-16 from the code at 6dbe6b8 (each value names its file, line and blob) so that the manuscript check does not need the git history.
